cards.model: Support asked for the permission details and I sent them the whole profile, which was more than they needed. Just to make sure I understood, you want the audit scoped to one profile. Would you mind confirming that in writing, so that support and I send the customer exactly the same answer? We used two different words for the same field last time, and if we had used the same word, the last ticket would not have gone wrong.
